skill2: Effect 3: Affects self. Scarlet Protection: Damage taken from Water Code enemies ▼ 17.95% continuously. This effect cannot be removed.

caveats: ⚑ 1 More: the burst's 1 More clause is literally gated on a Wind Code enemy being present, and BOTH the skill1 400.31% distributed hit and the skill2 Follow Up ATK grant are keyed to '1 More takes effect'. All three carry bossElementGate:'Wind', so all three are INERT against a non-Wind boss (including the neutral scope-lock boss). If in-game 1 More actually fires unconditionally and only the ATK▲45.33% is Wind-gated, this under-credits her by an entire 400.31% rider plus a team ATK grant — read the highest-priority open item before trusting any damage number.

⚑ Scarlet Flower duration: the kit states an EVENT deactivation ('When Full Burst ends'), not a timer. Encoded as durationSec 10.4 on the self Distributed Damage ▲90.01% (own Burst-III cast → 22f chain gap → 10s Full Burst). Any rotation where she does not complete the chain, or a Full Burst extended by an ally, makes this wrong in both directions.

⚑ Follow Up target set: the kit says 'all standard Burst 3 allies (except the skill user) in the Persona state'. The schema has no Persona-state facet, so the block targets alliesLowestAtk{count:4, burst:'III', excludeSelf:true} — the B3-except-self filter is faithful (count 4 ≥ the population, so the ATK ranking never bites), the 'in the Persona state' clause is DROPPED and OVER-CREDITS any B3 ally that is not a Persona unit.

⚑ Heals carry no HP amount: the engine's heal effect emits recovery events only, so the 5.7%-of-final-max-HP magnitude on both Media (skill1) and Mediarama (skill2) is unmodeled. Both are also modeled as SEPARATE 3-second channels, so during her Scarlet Flower window a heal-synergy teammate (on-recovery consumers) receives roughly double the recovery events it may actually get in game.

⚑ Cadence: MG datamine fields (reloadFrames 171, rate_of_fire, hitsPerShot 1) are the known-unreliable family and are inherited unchanged from base stats — hitsPerShot 1 on an MG is itself suspicious.
Scarlet Protection (Water Code damage taken ▼17.95%) is defensive with no consumer at scope (immortal boss, no HP pool) and is recorded in unmodeled, not as a block.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Second, independent prose→JSON read of yukiko (MG/Fire/Attacker/Burst III) authored BLIND from raw kit text + the schema; no override, test, probe data, board output or git history consulted. Damage surface: burst 1258.79% distributed + a 400.31% distributed rider on 1 More, both boosted by her own Fire Amp Distributed Damage ▲90.01% while Scarlet Flower is live. Sustain surface: Attack Damage ▲55.31% continuous, a 15s ATK ▲65.37% re-armed at battle start and every Full Burst end, Elemental Advantage Attack Damage ▲48.15% at Burst Stage 3 entry (Element bucket, live only with advantage), and a 25s casterAtkPct ▲80.25% Follow Up to B3 allies. Support surface: two independent 3-second heal channels (Media continuous, Mediarama only during Scarlet Flower) that emit recovery events for on-recovery consumers. Three blocks are Wind-gated via the 1 More clause and are therefore inert on a non-Wind boss.
